embeds.title: DBL GAME DAY
embeds.description: Live reaction for MLB games and DBL matchups.

fields.name: USE THIS ROOM FOR
fields.value: Live game chat • Matchup swings • Pitcher-start watching • Late-night West Coast lineup panic

fields.name: PROBABLE PITCHERS
fields.value: Each game day from late morning, one message lists every game's probable starters and tags pitchers on DBL rosters. It updates quietly when a team changes its starter.

fields.name: PICK'EM
fields.value: From Season 2027 the DBL League Bot posts each Week's matchups here. Pick the winners before the Week starts; a season leaderboard keeps score.

fields.name: KEEP IT READABLE
fields.value: Spoiler courtesy goes a long way. Use **💬│news-desk** for deeper discussion of a story.
